verses.en: For the Leader; with string-music. A Psalm, a Song.

verses.he: אֱלֹהִ֗ים יְחָנֵּ֥נוּ וִֽיבָרְכֵ֑נוּ יָ֤אֵ֥ר פָּנָ֖יו אִתָּ֣נוּ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.en: God be gracious unto us, and bless us; May He cause His face to shine toward us; Selah
That Thy way may be known upon earth, Thy salvation among all nations.

verses.he: יוֹד֖וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים׀ אֱלֹהִ֑ים י֝וֹד֗וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים כֻּלָּֽם׃
verses.en: Let the peoples give thanks unto Thee, O God; Let the peoples give thanks unto Thee, all of them. .

verses.he: יִֽשְׂמְח֥וּ וִֽירַנְּנ֗וּ לְאֻ֫מִּ֥ים כִּֽי־תִשְׁפֹּ֣ט עַמִּ֣ים מִישׁ֑וֹר וּלְאֻמִּ֓ים׀ בָּאָ֖רֶץ תַּנְחֵ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃
verses.en: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy; For Thou wilt judge the peoples with equity, And lead the nations upon earth. Selah

verses.he: יוֹד֖וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים׀ אֱלֹהִ֑ים י֝וֹד֗וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים כֻּלָּֽם׃
verses.en: Let the peoples give thanks unto Thee, O God; Let the peoples give thanks unto Thee, all of them.

verses.he: אֶ֭רֶץ נָתְנָ֣ה יְבוּלָ֑הּ יְ֝בָרְכֵ֗נוּ אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.en: The earth hath yielded her increase; May God, our own God, bless us.
May God bless us; And let all the ends of the earth fear Him.
